name: audiolla
description: Self-hosted audio-production API — stem separation, mastering, MIR analysis, DSP chains, MIDI, and AI restoration over REST and MCP.

audiolla_url.title: audiolla URL
audiolla_url.description: Base URL of your running audiolla server (AUDIOLLA_URL), e.g. http://localhost:8000.

audiolla_token.title: audiolla auth token
audiolla_token.description: Bearer token (AUDIOLLA_AUTH_TOKEN). Only needed if the server was started with AUDIOLLA_AUTH_TOKEN set.
